name: 3D Scanning & Motion Capture
description:
3D reconstruction, RGB-D scanning (Kinect, Tango, RealSense), ICP, camera tracking, sensor calibration, VolumetricFusion, Non-Rigid Registration, PoseTracking, Motion Capture, Body-, Face-, and Hand-Tracking, 3D DeepLearning, selected optimization techniques to solve the problem statements (GN, LM, gradient descent).

Some covered research projects:
Face Capture: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MMa2oT1wMIs&t=1s
Face2Face: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ohmajJTcpNk&t=6s
KinectFusion: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=quGhaggn3cQ
BundleFusion: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keIirXrRb1k&t=243s
DynamicFusion: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i1eZekcc_lM
prerequisites:
MA0902 Analysis for Informatics, 
MA0901 Linear Algebra for Informatics, 
C++ knowledge is required
